name: Are open floor plans good for multigenerational living?

mainEntity.name: Are open floor plans good for multigenerational living?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modified open plans work well—large great rooms connect kitchen/dining/living while pocket doors or screens create quiet zones when privacy is needed.
